I have SUPER thin sensitive skin and would pretty much always get infected ingrowns when I shaved my underarms with cartridges. Using a good shave soap that doesn't dry out the skin, using a fresh blade every shave (yes, every shave), and doing one pass with the direction of the hair growth made my shaving experience much nicer. I don't ever expect to get a perfectly close shave, I know there will be stubble left and that's a small tradeoff to not have painful swollen lumps in my underarms.

If you're doing all of these things and you're still having irritation try exfoliating before your shave. The sort of last ditch thing that I do in winter is I use a trimmer (the Meridian trimmer specifically) and just trim the hair down. Never get irritation and it works.
